hiw.title: Everything that happens before your first question
hiw.subtitle: Seven steps stand between you and the interview. Here's exactly what each one involves so there are no surprises on the day.
hiw.step1desc: Log in with the email and password you registered with. If you don't have an account yet, visit letshyre.com to create a candidate profile. Your account holds your interview slot, profile photo, and results.
hiw.step2desc: After signing in you'll land on your personal dashboard showing your profile and available interview slots. Click Take Interview to begin — the app immediately runs a background security check before anything else opens.
hiw.step3desc: The security scanner checks for applications that could compromise exam integrity — web browsers, screen recorders, AI assistants, and video-call tools. Any flagged app must be closed before you can proceed. The check re-runs until your environment is clean.
hiw.step3tip: Tip: close all other apps before clicking Take Interview
hiw.step4desc: You'll be prompted to allow access to your microphone, camera, and screen. All three are required for live proctoring. Grant each permission when your operating system asks — the interview cannot proceed without them.
hiw.step5desc: Read a short statement aloud for voice registration, then allow the camera to take a live photo. Your live image is compared against the profile photo you uploaded when creating your account. If the match fails, you'll be prompted to retake the photo in better lighting.
hiw.step5tip: Tip: face the camera directly in a well-lit room
hiw.step6desc: Select the position you're interviewing for. You can proceed with the role assigned during onboarding, or choose a different slot if multiple are available to you. The question set is tailored to the role you select here.
hiw.step7desc: You're all set. The interview window opens in full-screen with screen recording active. Answer each question within the allocated time — you can navigate between questions before the session timer runs out. Stay in the window at all times; navigating away counts as a violation.
hiw.ctaSub: Sign in to your account and click Take Interview when you're prepared.
